svg.aria-label: Figure 1, from merge to production in Jobbliggaren. A pull request passes CI and the review agents and is squashed to main. GitHub Actions, on a schedule (an hourly cron, of which GitHub starts a few runs a day): builds five images from one commit, scans each with Trivy, attests build provenance, and seals one immutable release record. The server, hourly: pulls the record, verifies signatures and the database schema, waits for healthy containers and writes a receipt. CI never connects to the server. To roll back, pin an earlier record.
